head: be8626212e1081b72f348131b8dfdac06715355e
title: fix(workouts): the client trains the sets the coach approved from Roman (B-ROMANADJ-125)
body:
Tier: T3
Why: the client's assigned-workout screen (core flow: train) shows and starts the set counts the coach approved from Roman, read from one additive server field; no auth, money, storage or flag change.
T4 trigger scan: none (display/start of the client's own assignment only; no auth, PII, money, credentials or destructive data).
T3 trigger scan: core flow (train): WorkoutAssignmentDetailScreen list and Start payload.
Bounded T1: NO (core-flow screen).
Canonical builder: Claude Opus 5.5 (B-ROMANADJ-125, agent 125)
Parent owner: operator agent 125
Acceptance evidence: src/__tests__/workoutAssignmentRomanSets125.test.tsx (6 tests): approved count shown and sent to Start with the "Updated by your coach" note on that exercise only; field missing (older server) = today's behaviour; empty list = no change; an order the plan no longer has is ignored; pure overlay keeps input unmutated and ignores malformed input. The screen tests fail on main (main renders and starts the live 4 sets). Local: new file 6/6, existing src/__tests__/workoutAssignmentNamesUx124.test.tsx 8/8.
Promotion triggers: replacing the live plan with the snapshot wholesale, or any change to which assignment is read.

## Fixes
- B (AUDIT-07-125 / AUDIT-14-125 B2): a coach approves Roman's set cut in the Action Queue and the card says it was applied, but the client opens the workout and still sees and starts the old sets, because this screen renders and starts `workout_plan.exercises` while roman-adjust writes only the assignment snapshot.

## Change
- New `src/utils/workout/romanAdjustedSets.ts`: `overlayRomanAdjustedSets(exercises, roman_adjusted_sets)` lays the approved set counts over the live plan by `order`; malformed entries and unknown orders are ignored.
- `WorkoutAssignmentDetailScreen` uses the overlaid rows for the list and for Start (`buildActiveWorkoutExercises`), and shows "Updated by your coach" under an adjusted exercise. Coach live edits (reps, load, rest, notes, added exercises) stay visible because only Roman's set counts are overlaid.
- `ClientWorkoutAssignmentWithPlan.roman_adjusted_sets?` added to the API type.

## Works against the current production backend
- Production does not send `roman_adjusted_sets` yet: the field is optional and a missing value renders exactly today's screen (tested). Once the companion backend PR deploys, approved changes appear with no app update. Companion: growth-project-backend#800.

## Overlap
- No open PR touches WorkoutAssignmentDetailScreen.tsx, workoutBuilderApi.ts or utils/workout/. Rebased on current main (8fac2fa2, includes m#422).
